title: Six looks into a log of 2,400,000 lines
caption: Searching a log written in time order for the first line at or after 03:14:00. Each step reads one line, in the middle of whatever is still in play, and the timestamp there throws away the half that cannot hold the answer. Nothing is compared twice and nothing is compared cleverly: the only work per step is one look. Six steps take the window from 2,400,000 lines to 37,499. Twenty-two take it to one.

answer.label: looks to pin down one line in 2,400,000
